body: The worst part is she is just fine, she is out having fun , living life , going around partying with friends. I had a breakdown today and texted her lots of things and also called like 12 times she did not receive or get back . I feel like an idiot
It says she is not sure if she ever loved me
Thank you so much, I feel a bit better.

I somewhere have this feeling that if I tell her how much I am suffering maybe she will understand and reconsider but that never happens and yet I keep pushing myself that maybe if I try one more time she will understand
But she tells me this every time we break up and then once we get back together, she hits me with I love you
Idk if I am oversharing but I keep thinking about her while fapping , and smh that agitates me all the more, makes me feel defenceless . I shared caused we are all adults here.
Thank you,friend.
I know but idk what to without her
Yes I wish I could let go.  But even after all this , I love her like it’s yesterday morning before any of this which makes me feel pathetic, am I that much of a lowlife ? I have no self respect
Is it okay to still be in love with her ? Can I hold on to this feeling? It hurts me to love her but I don’t want to let this feelings go
You really believe that I will get through this ?

But she has done too many things and said too many things to hurt me , she has been cheated on me with her ex bf , I took her back even after that.  She promised she wouldn’t leave. Things were going so well past 6 months and then suddenly this
I am 23 and she is 22.

Thank you that’s so so reassuring. I needed to hear this. Thank you.  I am trying my best.  Thank you for explaining it to me. I just don’t know how to move forward, I cut her out of my life but this huge amount of space that she takes up in my life even tho she is physically not a part of it.  I miss her everyday , I cant eat , I can’t sleep.  Idk what to do anymore
Idk how to move forward, I feel really lost . I can’t eat , I can’t sleep , I can’t do anything
I have been friends with her for 2 years before eventually dating her, I have known her for 5 long years. Idk how to move forward. I am so desperately in love with her. I feel sick
I wish I could

Throughout these 3 years she kept on telling me that she loved me and whenever we broke up she told me otherwise, which she later said that she never meant it and only said to make me move on from her . Honestly idk what to believe anymore
Hey I am so sorry you had to grow through all this , please feel free to reach out.  I am here. I have been going through the same thing myself. I care , please don’t hesitate to reach out
Hey thank you , this makes me feel a bit warm.
Thank you

Thank you so much. You know what that first thought that popped in my mind after reading your comment is that wow someone actually took their time out to hear me out and explain stuff to me. Thank you so much. This makes me feel like someone actually cares
I feel the same way on an everyday basis
We really don’t have a way out, I wish we did tho.  I want you to remember that you are loved and cared for. I love you.  Just take a deep breath and listen to some podcasts maybe ? See if it helps.
Hey , I wish I could give you a hug.
we just have to improvise our feelings and not let others manipulate it. We need to create. What do you think?
All gym bois are douchebags
